error_codes.missing_multipliers: The result carries no Lagrange multipliers (kinematic result).
error_codes.not_kinematically_driven: Inverse dynamics needs drives for every degree of freedom.
error_codes.not_portable: A Python callback cannot be serialized or imported.
error_codes.schema_mismatch: The payload is not the expected schema family.
error_codes.solve_failed: Generic singular, inconsistent, or divergent solve.
error_codes.unsupported_schema_version: The payload schema version cannot be read.

operations.name: capabilities
operations.summary: Static description of supported dimensions, joints, solvers and limits.

operations.name: load
operations.summary: Rebuild a planar mechanism from a portable mbsd.planar.mechanism payload.

operations.name: validate
operations.summary: Pre-solve report: DOF, rank, portability, table domains, resource limits.

operations.name: solve_kinematics
operations.summary: Position, velocity and acceleration of a fully driven mechanism.

operations.name: simulate
operations.summary: Forward constrained dynamics; the result carries sampled multipliers.

operations.name: inverse_dynamics
operations.summary: Multipliers that sustain a fully driven motion.

operations.name: joint_loads
operations.summary: Named joint reactions, drive efforts and the frame (shaking) load.

operations.name: check
operations.summary: Pass/fail verdict: residuals, energy drift or equation-of-motion balance.

operations.name: export_model
operations.summary: Write the portable mechanism payload (mbsd.planar.mechanism v1).

operations.name: export_joint_loads
operations.summary: Write the joint-load history payload (mbsd.planar.joint_loads v1).
